modules.module_title: Install pump and related equipment

pcs.pc_description: understand water supply and drainage systems in rural India
assemble pump components, equipment and prepare the tools, area and materials for the task as per Manufacturer's policy
locate and mark position for inlet and outlet supply connections of pump
fix the pump at the designated location as per instruction and connect the hoses of inlet and outlet supply to the pump
make provisions for electrical and other required connections
install and connect pump components without any damage to pump, fixture, pipe work and the surrounding environment followed by adjusting the pressure/flow as per required supply and demand
check for cracks, defects and anomalies in the pumping apparatus, condition of couplings in the equipment, pumping on both suction and discharge sides
• check the oil level, fuel level, radiator coolant, air release valve and engine condition of a diesel operated pump and prime the same • .
understand the usages and installation of different valves pertaining to plumbing and water management

modules.module_title: Operate the pump

pcs.pc_description: prepare a schedule for running the main pumps and the standby
prime the centrifugal pump before start of operations before ensuring operation of the pump with full efficiency to improve output gain

operate the delivery valve; close bypass valves of reflux valve, sluice valve and butterfly valve; monitor sound, vibration, temperature and other related parameters to ensure smooth operation of the pump
check pump motor alignment and maintain input/output parameters
inspect the pump, related machinery and water supply system for faults, leaks, sparks, improper functioning, wear and tear or evidence of tampering
maintain a record of all pump operations timings, voltage, current, reading on gauges and flow meter, temperature, water level and any problem that occurred during the operations
perform operations on 3-Phase & Single- Phase Pump Operation Connections

modules.module_title: Maintain the pump and related machinery

pcs.pc_description: identify, repair or replace sparking motors, leaking or worn out parts and tighten the foundation bolts
calibrate all vital instruments such as pressure gauge, vaccum gauge, ammeter, voltmeter, watt meters, frequency meter, tachometer and flow meter
conduct performance test of the pump discharge, head, efficiency and troubleshoot faults as per standard operating procedures
conduct various operations on pump control panel board for 3-phase and single phase pump

modules.module_title: Maintain sump and storage tanks

pcs.pc_description: dewater, clean, disinfect and rinse sump and tank as per standard operating procedures

modules.module_title: Maintain water meters and flow meters

pcs.pc_description: clean the dirt box or strainer and replace gaskets upon its wear and tear
prevent water seepage into the water meter and clean the chamber where the meter is installed
disassemble and reassemble the water meter for verification or repair
check the range, zero setting of the flow meter, inspect for bearing wear out and deposits in flow meter or corrosion of attached pipes
take action as per standard operating procedure to troubleshoot common faults in water meters and flow meters

modules.module_title: Operate, maintain and repair pipelines and water treatment units

pcs.pc_description: operate water pipelines with required pressure by opening and shutting off the valves gradually
flush the system to clear sediments; service the valve chamber and valves; inspect the pipelines for damage, wear and tear, leakage, entrainment and water hammer and locate the leaks in the pipes
repair damaged pipelines and replace faulty parts like gaskets, valves joints and pipes that are not repairable
start and shut off the filtration process and adjust the rate of filtration as needed by adding chemicals
inspect equipment on a regular basis to ensure proper functioning and adherence to safety standards; monitor operating conditions, meters, gauges and collect and test water and sewage samples
record meter, gauge readings, and operational data to operate equipment
clean and maintain equipment, tanks, filter beds and other work areas
